intro.t: Say what you think, then hand the turn back. A question at the end shows the examiner you can really talk WITH someone.

close.t: Great. Remember: your opinion first, then the question. Never the question alone.

reels.note: The simplest way to share the conversation.

ex.t: I think they should, at least during lessons. {What do you think?}
I study better on my own, because friends distract me. {What do you think?}
ex.q: Is it better to study alone or with friends?

ex.t: Definitely! We already spend six hours a day at school. {What do you think?}

reels.note: Very natural for a teenager. Use it after a personal answer.

ex.t: I prefer a few close friends I can really trust. {What about you?}
ex.q: Is it better to have lots of friends or a few close ones?

ex.t: I'd choose a city, because there's always something to do. {What about you?}
ex.q: Is it better to grow up in a city or a small town?

ex.t: For me, enjoying it matters more. I don't want to be bored every day. {What about you?}
ex.q: Is it more important to enjoy your job or to earn a lot of money?

reels.note: After a strong opinion, it opens the door to a real discussion.

ex.t: I think it should, because lots of teenagers don't do any exercise. {Do you agree?}
ex.q: Should sport be compulsory at school?

ex.t: Not really. Most people sit down all day at work or at school. {Do you agree?}
ex.q: Do you think people exercise enough these days?

ex.t: I don't think so. It's much harder to concentrate at home. {Do you agree?}
ex.q: Is online learning as good as learning in a classroom?

reels.note: Narrows the question, so your partner has something specific to answer.

ex.t: I think a small job teaches you a lot. {What do you think about} working at weekends?
It would really help families. {What do you think about} the cost for the city?
ex.q: Should public transport be free for teenagers?

ex.t: It's a great idea. {What do you think about} making it a weekly lesson?
ex.q: Should everyone learn to cook at school?

reels.note: Takes the discussion one step further.

ex.t: I think we do, honestly. {Do you think} adults are any better?
ex.q: Do you think young people spend too much time on their phones?

ex.t: Not always. Some games are really creative. {Do you think} they can teach you anything?
ex.q: Are video games a waste of time?

ex.t: It helps you stay in touch. But {do you think} it makes friendships less real?
ex.q: Is social media good or bad for friendships?

reels.p: What about …? Do you think that's important too?
reels.bt: What about…? Do you think that's important too?
reels.note: The strongest version: you give your partner a real idea to react to.

ex.t: We can recycle and walk more. {What about} buying less? {Do you think that's important too?}
ex.q: What can young people do to help the environment?

ex.t: Patience is the most important thing. {What about} humour? {Do you think that's important too?}
ex.q: What makes someone a good teacher?

ex.t: Yes, because nobody teaches us about saving. {What about} bank accounts? {Do you think that's important too?}
ex.q: Should young people learn how to manage money at school?
